title: filenode-server rustdoc broken intra-doc-link to crate::memory::MemoryBackend behind feature gate
description:
crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/backend.rs:144 has an intra-doc-link `[`MemoryBackend`]: crate::memory::MemoryBackend` but the `memory` module is gated behind `#[cfg(feature = "memory")]` (lib.rs:42-43). Default rustdoc invocation runs without features, so the link is unresolved:

```
error: unresolved link to `crate::memory::MemoryBackend`
   --> crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/backend.rs:144:28
```

Reproduces with: `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p jmap-filenode-server --no-deps`. Passes with `--all-features`.

Two fix options:
(a) Add `--all-features` to the standard rustdoc gate so feature-gated items are included.
(b) Make the doc-link conditional, or replace with a plain markdown reference that doesn't require resolution.

Pre-existing breakage — discovered during JMAP-510h.26 (test-only change) when running the crate's pre-commit rustdoc gate. Parallel to bd:JMAP-m1yd (sharing-server rustdoc breakage).

Workspace-wide audit: every `*-server` crate that has a `memory` module behind a feature gate may have similar links. The fix likely belongs at the workspace level (run rustdoc with `--all-features` everywhere, or remove the feature-gated module pattern, or use conditional doc-links systematically).
close_reason: Batch 11: committed and adversarially verified (or already fixed); CI green at cc87669d
